description:
Very few jobs will survive AI...

Seth Godin says if you can write down exactly what you do all day, you can give those rules to AI and eventually it will do it better 🤷‍♂️

The value will be in the things that are harder to replicate: your experiences, relationships, judgement and perspective.

The more human you can be, the harder you are to replace.

Comment ‘Seth’ and we’ll DM you the full conversation.
